item.description:
What's New

  • You can now password protect your shared links. After toggling this on, the link + the password will be copied to your clipboard.
  • After creating a note you can now have Cleft automatically copy either the link, the markdown, or both to your clipboard

Bug Fixes

  • Cleft was not letting you always create or add to a note if you had a filter selected
  • We fixed an issue with the mic not working the first time you try to record

What's New

  • Add new voice recordings to existing notes! Hit that big plus button inside the note.
  • You can now change your name or account email in the app's settings.
  • Added horizontal line breaks when you merge notes or append new audio to a note.
  • No more interrupted thoughts. We listened (literally!) - the sensitivity has been turned down so now Cleft will only “ping” you when it can’t hear you in the first few seconds of your note.

Bug Fixes

  • If you refresh with CMD+R while viewing a note, it now updates too instead of showing the cached version.
  • The Obsidian plugin now works on Mac. Sorry about that everyone. We broke it at some point and now it's back to syncing properly.

What's New

  • Resolved an issue where subscription status did not always trigger UI elements correctly.
  • Removed noise hallucinations for better transcripts.
  • Added an alert and a sound for when the app cannot hear you.
  • New sound alerts for recording start and stop.
  • No longer show an active visualizer during paused recordings.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash when navigating back to the list view after immediately playing a note.
  • Resolved an issue with downloading merged audio files.
